description: This file defines the NodePairingApprovalPrompter class responsible for managing node pairing approval prompts within a macOS application. It handles loading pairing requests, presenting alerts to the user, processing responses, automating silent approvals via SSH, and maintaining synchronization with other instances through periodic reconciliation.

classes.name: NodePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class managing node pairing approval prompts, handling request loading, alert presentation, user responses, silent SSH approvals, and periodic state reconciliation.

classes.name: PairingList
classes.description: Contains lists of pending and paired node requests for synchronization.

classes.name: PairedNode
classes.description: Represents an approved or paired node with its identifying and version information.

classes.name: PendingRequest
classes.description: Represents a pending node pairing request, including metadata and state.

classes.name: SSHTarget
classes.description: Represents SSH connection details with host and port.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the pairing prompt handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops and cleans up ongoing pairing prompt activities.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously loads pending pairing requests from the gateway, with retry logic.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Processes loaded pairing requests, updates internal state, and manages alert presentation.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string for a pending request.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Presents a user alert for a pairing request.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Processes the user's response to a pairing alert.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends approval for a pairing request and updates gateway accordingly.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects a pairing request through the gateway.

methods.name: trySilentApproveIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts to silently approve a pairing request via SSH if conditions are met.

methods.name: resolveSSHTarget
methods.description: Determines the SSH target for silent approval based on configuration or local network discovery.
